title: Central Midtown
subtitle: Conversations with the artists, counselors, and organizers of Midtown Mobile.
description:
Central Midtown is a building in Midtown Mobile, Alabama that houses nonprofits, counselors, and working artists. Its position is that beauty is born in the margins. This show is a set of conversations with the people in that building and that neighborhood: what they make, who they serve, and why they stayed.

Each episode is one long conversation, lightly edited, with links to the guest's work in the show notes. Every episode has a full transcript.
author: Central Midtown
